what: Why campaign_v7 stopped promoting after cycle 118. The self-distillation loop did NOT run out of signal: a depth-7 search still disagrees with its own net on 57.5% of best moves and by 617 cp on average. What collapsed is the OBJECTIVE'S ABILITY TO SEE that signal, because BCE through sigmoid(cp/400) loses gradient exactly where a strengthening net puts its evaluations.
headline: Measurement failure at the top of the range, not signal exhaustion.

true_effect_size.what: candidate vs the frozen cycle-118 active model, blend 75, --same-search, pooled from the gate's OWN confirmation batches
true_effect_size.note: FLAT, not decaying. Independently recomputed from the batch JSONs, pairing on pair_index with a 6400-pair bootstrap.

the_stall.verdict: The gate is correct to reject: the true effect is half its indifference point.

correction_to_an_earlier_measurement.claim: A 1000-game paired A/B (c141 vs c118) measured +20.5 Elo, 95% CI [+4.9, +35.9].
correction_to_an_earlier_measurement.reality: A high outlier. 12,800 games of the SAME comparison already existed in the gate's confirmation artifacts and give +4.91. The 1000-game CI's LOWER BOUND was the truth.
correction_to_an_earlier_measurement.lesson: Never trust a 1000-game point estimate when the gate has already played 12,800 games of the identical comparison and written them to disk.

hypothesis_tested_and_REFUTED_frozen_tea.hypothesis: active_model_path is both actor and relabel teacher and advances only on gate acceptance, so it has been frozen at cycle 118 for 28 cycles; unfreezing it should restore learning.
hypothesis_tested_and_REFUTED_frozen_tea.test: Relabelled 3000 identical positions from cycle_000146/selfplay_jsonl with the c118 teacher and the c146 net, both at depth 7, blend 75, max-nodes 144000. Measured the divergence between the two label sets in the space the loss actually uses.
hypothesis_tested_and_REFUTED_frozen_tea.verdict: REFUTED. Swapping the teacher offers 3% of the signal the learner has ALREADY failed to extract from its current labels. The frozen teacher is not the binding constraint, and the 1.5-hour unfreeze experiment was correctly skipped.

hypothesis_tested_and_PARTLY_REFUTED_amp.hypothesis: The loop is a geometric amplification series: search beats the net by A, distillation recovers alpha*A, promotion installs it, and A shrinks each round until gains fall below the gate floor. Predicts A shrinking across the lineage.
hypothesis_tested_and_PARTLY_REFUTED_amp.test: Same 2000 positions labelled by four retained arch-v2 nets at depth 1 and depth 7 (blend 75, max-nodes 144000, 24 threads). A = divergence between a net's depth-7 search and its own depth-1 view.
hypothesis_tested_and_PARTLY_REFUTED_amp.verdict: PARTLY REFUTED, and this is the key finding. In cp space the teachable signal did NOT shrink -- it GREW (566 -> 617 mean |dcp|) and best-move disagreement stayed near 58-60%. Measured through sigmoid(cp/400) the same signal fell 26.5%. The amplification is intact; the objective's view of it is collapsing.

mechanism.statement: As the net strengthens its evaluations become more decisive (larger |cp|). That moves the teacher-vs-net differences out of the responsive middle of sigmoid(cp/400) and into its flat tail, where the loss has almost no gradient. Getting stronger is what made the net invisible to its own loss.
mechanism.corroborating_symptom: WDL loss sits 0.0234 nats from its label-entropy floor (0.5547) while cp RMSE is 272 cp and predictions inflate 31% (pred_mean_abs 524 vs target_mean_abs 399). The net is near-perfect on what it is scored on and poor at the magnitudes search actually consumes for pruning margins and move ordering.

how_the_ceiling_got_installed.note: Two individually-justified decisions at v7's founding interacted in a way that appeared in no single review.
how_the_ceiling_got_installed.change_1: TEACHER_MIX 0.8 -> 1.0. Justified in the conf: at 0.8 a teacher row's target was 20% game outcome, injecting +/-49 cp of noise on equal positions and compressing a +1200 cp eval to +846.
how_the_ceiling_got_installed.change_2: TEACHER_SAMPLE_FRACTION 0.15 -> 1.0 with RELABEL_EVERY 6 -> 1, so every position carries a teacher label.
how_the_ceiling_got_installed.interaction: run_vast_campaign_v2.sh still documents the design assumption: 'Rows WITHOUT a teacher label are unaffected - they always target the outcome alone.' That was the balance. With 100% coverage there are no such rows. Verified on cycle 146: train_records_with_teacher_value 4,317,645 == train_samples 4,317,645.
how_the_ceiling_got_installed.consequence: The game outcome -- the only signal in the system not derived from the net's own search -- was switched off, making the loop's fixed point exactly 'reproduce my own depth-7 search', a ceiling the net can actually reach.

also_refuted.optimizer_pathology: Adam beta2=0.999 gives v a 693-step half-life vs ~340 retained steps/cycle; measured mean_sqrt_vhat flat 7.35e-8 -> 7.33e-8 and the step multiplier rose 24% over 7 cycles. Adam is scale-invariant. Dead.
also_refuted.blend_ceiling: Blend 100 is attempted FIRST every cycle and loses by ~46 Elo; 0 acceptances in 51 lineage-wide attempts. The PST term is inside the net's target function because every label is the blend-75 engine's own search score.

free_compute_unrelated_to_the_stall.epochs: EPOCHS=3 but held-out loss rises after epoch 1 in 8/8 cycles and epoch 3 was selected 0/8 (best_epoch in {1,1,1,1,1,1,2,2}). ~2/3 of GPU train time is discarded.
free_compute_unrelated_to_the_stall.selection_split: Checkpoint selection uses a reference split labelled by the CYCLE-98 net at DEPTH 6 while training targets come from c118 at depth 7. It optimizes agreement with an obsolete, weaker teacher and caused 2/8 backwards selections.

implication_for_throughput_work: Faster cycles do not add Elo to a loop whose loss cannot see the remaining signal. The 2026-08-15 gate change (4.09x, cycles 62 -> 25 min) and the _pack_batch optimisation buy DIAGNOSTIC speed, not strength. They were still worth having: this diagnosis took an evening instead of a week.
prescription_v8: Add a cp-space term to the loss so gradient survives at the magnitudes where the signal now lives: BCE(pred/400, target_wdl) + lambda * Huber(pred_cp, target_cp, delta=100). Both kernels already exist at train_torch.py:595-609; only the sum is new.
TEACHER_MIX 1.0 -> 0.9 to restore the outcome signal that is not bounded by the net's own search.

Objective-identity fields change, so this requires a NEW LINEAGE: fresh OUT_ROOT, fresh Adam, weights-only bootstrap from cycle 146. Keeps 146 cycles of learned weights; discards optimizer moments and the replay buffer.
caveats: The amplification table is 2000 positions with KL ~0.005; the DIRECTION is clear, the -26.5% magnitude carries real uncertainty.
Depth 1 is a proxy for 'what the net knows directly'; it still includes quiescence search, so it is not a pure static eval.
All label divergences were measured on positions generated by the frozen c118 actor, so the position distribution is controlled but not representative of what a stronger actor would visit.
